caption:
Standard deviation, explained without a formula.

Two classes both average 80, but 60 to 100 is far more spread out than 78 to 82, so it has the larger standard deviation.

Follow @samsonsatprep for daily SAT tips.
tiktok_caption: Standard deviation just means spread. No formula needed.

youtube.title: Standard Deviation Explained Without a Formula
youtube.description: Standard deviation measures how spread out data is around the mean. Two data sets can share a mean of 80 but have very different spreads.
